title: This $20 AI creative app does more than generate images
excerpt: Turn ideas into visuals in minutes.
content_html:
TL;DR: ARTA combines AI image generation, video creation, avatars, photo editing, and more into one app. Get a one-year Premium subscription for $19.97 (reg. $39.99).

Credit: AIBY

$19.97
$39.99 Save $20.02

AI image generators used to mean typing a prompt and hoping the result looked anything like what you had in mind. Now they’re generating videos, editing selfies, creating professional headshots, and even letting you try on virtual outfits. ARTA puts all of that into one app, and for a limited time, you can grab a 1-year subscription for only $19.97 (reg. $39.99).

Built on AI models including Flux, GPT-4o, and Nano Banana, ARTA can create everything from realistic headshots and social media graphics to stylized artwork, product mockups, and short AI-generated videos. Upload a photo to swap outfits, experiment with different hairstyles, remove distracting objects, or generate an entirely new look without opening a complicated editing program.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

ARTA isn’t just for chasing the latest AI trend, either. You can use it for work, too. Mock up marketing concepts, design presentation graphics, generate blog illustrations, create eye-catching thumbnails, or quickly produce visuals for social posts when stock photos just won’t cut it. With more than 45 art styles and customizable aspect ratios, there’s enough flexibility to create images that fit your project instead of the other way around.

The Premium plan includes 500 credits every week, which refresh automatically for AI images, avatar packs, videos, and edits. Because ARTA works on iPhone, Android, and desktop — and has earned more than 78,000 four-star reviews on the App Store — you can start a project on your phone and finish it wherever it’s most convenient.

图片来源：AIBY

$19.97
$39.99 Save $20.02

人工智能图像生成器过去意味着输入提示并希望结果看起来像你想要的那样。 现在他们可以生成视频、编辑自拍照、创建专业的头像，甚至让你试穿虚拟服装。 ARTA 将所有这些功能整合到一个应用程序中，在有限的时间内，您只需 19.97 美元（原价 39.99 美元）即可获得 1 年期订阅。

ARTA 基于 Flux、GPT-4o 和 Nano Banana 等 AI 模型构建，可以创建从逼真的头像和社交媒体图形到风格化的艺术作品、产品模型和 AI 生成的短视频等一切内容。 上传照片来交换服装、尝试不同的发型、删除分散注意力的物体或生成全新的外观，而无需打开复杂的编辑程序。

ARTA 也不仅仅是为了追逐最新的人工智能趋势。 您也可以将它用于工作。 模拟营销概念、设计演示图形、生成博客插图、创建引人注目的缩略图，或者在库存照片无法满足要求时快速生成社交帖子的视觉效果。 拥有超过 45 种艺术风格和可定制的宽高比，有足够的灵活性来创建适合您的项目的图像，而不是相反。

高级计划包括每周 500 个积分，这些积分会自动刷新以获取 AI 图像、头像包、视频和编辑。 由于 ARTA 适用于 iPhone、Android 和桌面设备，并且在 App Store 上获得了超过 78,000 条四星评价，因此您可以在手机上开始一个项目，并在最方便的地方完成它。
